what: every muscle mesh of the named pages, measured off the SHIPPED geometry; read-only

bucket_rule.repairable: one or more severity-2/3 geometric checks, but not two severity-3 ones
bucket_rule.not_defensible: two or more independent severity-3 geometric checks; OR the mesh was generated here (rule_based / mirror_fill) and fails even one severity-3 check, because then there is no real source behind it to fall back on
bucket_rule.note: Only GEOMETRIC checks -- the ones with a threshold the project already set -- decide a bucket. The architecture ratios (vol_ratio_lit / acsa_ratio_lit) have no project threshold and are recorded as supporting evidence only, in bucket_because.architecture_evidence.

threshold_provenance.largest_component_frac: docs/MUSCLE_GAPS.md (the ECRL ship: 94.6 % in one component)
threshold_provenance.vol_ratio_lit / acsa_ratio_lit: NO project threshold exists; the numbers are reported raw

literature_volume_note: DERIVED, not measured: V = sum over the entity's functional_compartments of PCSA * optimal_fascicle_length / cos(pennation), and ACSA = sum PCSA * cos(pennation), from the muscle's OWN cited architecture record in data/muscles/**/*.json (Ward 2009 and the other sources each record names). It is a literature-architecture implication, never a measured cadaver volume.
